# P09 · Content pipeline: drafting, gates, review queue, publish — tasks

**Goal (3 lines):** Call 5 drafts a SUB-SFL track (6 lessons and one model-lesson script, hi and en) from the error, templates, strategies and up to 3 approved method cards. Code fills class-number slots and checks arithmetic; gates 1, 1b and call 7 check it; the coach reviews it in the P3 queue (edit, approve, reject with a structured reason), the officer activates it (the two keys), and approved lessons are voiced and published in a manifest. Rejections feed call 7.

**Read:** `BUILD_PROMPTS.md` P09 (incl. D1-D3, E4-E5, C5); design call 5, guardrails; `addendum-v3.1.md` §D, §E; `CLAUDE.md` §4 (rules 1, 3, 4, 7, 10, 14), §7; existing `ai/guard/gates.py`, `ai/guard/rejections.py`, `ai/validators/{arithmetic,check_items}.py`, `services/pilot/{lessons,audio}.py` (the pilot already runs gates, a review queue, rejection examples and voicing for 3 template lessons: reused, not rebuilt), `services/api/db.py` (`ReviewItem`, `ReviewDecision`), `services/api/roles/permissions.yaml`.

**Starting commit:** `f99d5bf` · **Started:** 2026-10-26

**Merged:** the one v3 carry-over item from `MIGRATION-v1-v3.md` (step 10 model runs) is T12 below.
